```yaml
name: Check Branch Alias

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  check-branch-alias:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
      
    - name: Setup PHP
      uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
      with:
        php-version: '8.1'
        extensions: mbstring, intl
        coverage: none
        
    - name: Install Composer dependencies
      run: |
        composer install --no-progress --no-suggest
        
    - name: Run PHPStan
      run: |
        vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --level=7 --error-format=checkstyle src/ | tee phpstan-report.xml
      continue-on-error: true
      
    - name: Run PHPUnit tests
      run: |
        vendor/bin/phpunit --verbose
        
    - name: Validate branch alias
      run: |
        # Check if branch alias is properly set in composer.json
        BRANCH_ALIAS=$(jq -r '.extra."branch-alias"."dev-main"' composer.json)
        if [[ "$BRANCH_ALIAS" == "null" ]]; then
          echo "Branch alias not found in composer.json"
          exit 1
        fi
        echo "Branch alias found: $BRANCH_ALIAS"
        
    - name: Verify commit message format
      run: |
        # Check if commit messages follow conventional commit format
        git log --oneline -10 | grep -E "^(feat|fix|docs|style|refactor|test|chore)\(.*\): .+" || true
        
    - name: Check for security vulnerabilities
      run: |
        # Run security checker
        if command -v composer-security-checker; then
          composer-security-checker
        elif [ -f "vendor/bin/security-checker" ]; then
          vendor/bin/security-checker local
        fi
```
